in_hebrew.name: Sherlock
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Sherlock הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English ‘scir’ meaning ‘bright’ or ‘shining’ and ‘hroc’ meaning ‘hawk’ or ‘ruler’. The name Sherlock has been popularized by the fictional detective character of the same name.

in_latin.name: Sherlock
